title: Minyamin, an Egyptian convert
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Yevamot 76b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.76b.3): Rabbi Yehudah said, “Minyamin, an Egyptian convert, was a fellow student of mine among Rabbi Akiva’s disciples.” Hyman cites [Tosefta Kiddushin, chapter 5](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Kiddushin.5.6), where Rabbi Akiva tells him, “Binyamin, you have erred.” Hyman identifies him as Minyamin.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Rabbi Yehudah calls Minyamin a fellow disciple of Rabbi Akiva. Hyman identifies him with the Binyamin whom Rabbi Akiva addresses in the Tosefta.

The reply is at [Tosefta Kiddushin 5:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Kiddushin.5.6) and at [5:4 in Lieberman’s edition](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Kiddushin_(Lieberman).5.4). Both give Binyamin.
